summary.prose: Build one checkout-level owner for generated output and bounded test lifetimes, and route developer commands through it before migrating consumers. Then repair fixture readiness and isolated compiler probes, followed by focused validation. This revision changes task order and strengthens actual-consumer evidence; completed ownership/coordinator work and the approved design scope are retained.

tasks.title: Reconcile the implementation baseline
tasks.summary: Inspect and integrate upstream changes while preserving local artifacts; verify quiescence before shared-output work.
acceptanceChecks: Record the resulting commit and any overlaps with the approved LLD; stop for a design amendment if behavior changed materially.
No active prior test/build owner; no unknown probe residue or real daemon is removed.

tests.name: Baseline commit, upstream overlap and quiescent-owner evidence

tasks.title: Establish run ownership and runtime context
tasks.summary: Add proposed scripts/test-harness/context.mjs contracts for canonical-root lease identity, runtime preflight, child environment, bounded budgets, run workspace and explicit recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Two checkout aliases contend for one lease; malformed/replaced/symlinked/abandoned records fail closed without PID/age takeover.
Unsupported runtime fails before mutation; nested child environment uses the validated Node22 binary, preserves explicit live opt-ins, and never leaks environment values.
Record transitions permit release only with matching identity and confirmed closure; unconfirmed cleanup or abandoned ownership retains blocked state. t3 integrates actual actor draining.

tests.name: Canonical-path contenders refuse overlap and preserve foreign/replaced/symlinked ownership
Unsupported Node refuses before mutation and child environment resolves selected runtime
Abandoned ownership cannot be stolen by age or PID absence

tasks.title: Coordinate builds and test admission
tasks.summary: Add proposed scripts/test-harness/build.mjs and run.mjs; preserve all existing build stages, prepare output once and schedule a serial mutation lane before bounded readers.
acceptanceChecks: Second build/test refuses before shared mutation; standalone build acquires ownership; only admitted preparing/mutating writers can join with one writer reservation.
Prepared metadata requires successful build, required helpers and stable input/output fingerprints; drift invalidates validation.
Selectors deduplicate and reject empty/outside paths; default concurrency2 bounded1–4; documented longer intentional file budgets remain possible and recorded.
Owned child results, logs, coverage and close confirmation survive failures and catchable signals.
Real disposable-child SIGINT and SIGTERM controls stop admission, drain owned actors and return incomplete/nonzero; no closure acknowledgment retains blocked ownership.

tests.name: Prepared build excludes simultaneous writers and readers, validates helpers and rejects fingerprint drift
SIGINT/SIGTERM and deadline drain registered actors or retain blocked incomplete outcome
Selector deduplication, explicit budgets and bounded concurrency reject invalid admission

tasks.title: Route supported commands and regression launchers
tasks.summary: Switch root build/test and VSCode test commands to ownership, move mutating pretest asset sync inside admission, and adapt specialized regression launchers at their ownership seam.
acceptanceChecks: Both packages use canonical checkout ownership; asset sync cannot run before overlap refusal and keeps existing semantics.
Existing workspace/typecheck/spawn-scan/native/model/assets stages remain checked; only wrapper exposure assertions change here.
Specialized scripts retain proof/gate policy; altered fingerprints stay pending Batch15 with no fabricated qualification.

tests.name: Root and VSCode command overlap refuses before asset synchronization
Build stages and specialized launcher gate policies survive wrapper integration
Native refusal and saved-mode controls remain enforced

tasks.title: Migrate rebuild fixtures to prepared output
tasks.summary: Replace five ordinary build hooks with prepared-context checks; keep src/daemon/__tests__/review-retirement-package.test.ts as a real exclusive rebuild regression.
acceptanceChecks: All six audited consumers participate; direct unsupported invocations fail with an actionable selector command before fake-daemon startup.
The retirement regression still plants stale output and asserts its removal/package behavior; prepared output refreshes before readers.
Focused consumers cannot lose compiled helpers through concurrent cleanup; no native refusal assertion is weakened.

Positive reuse evidence executes all five actual consumer files under prepared ownership, preserves their assertions and logs, and explicitly distinguishes remaining native/platform failures from missing prerequisites or harness races; repeating the prerequisite function alone is insufficient.

tests.name: Five prepared consumers reuse helpers and raw invocations refuse missing context
Retirement-package stale-output rebuild remains a serial mutation regression

tasks.title: Repair fixture readiness and resource lifetimes
tasks.summary: Use existing process/channel helpers with per-case cleanup and bounded ready handshakes; move peer MessageChannel allocation into a meaningful test with finally cleanup.
acceptanceChecks: Importing the peer file creates no unowned module-scope port; its real state round-trip test terminates and both ports close.
Failed fixture startup releases owned socket/process before next case; short behavior deadlines begin only after bounded readiness.
Cancellation and disposal retain actual handles; escaped/unconfirmed children block release rather than authorizing PID scans or production lifecycle changes.

tests.name: Peer state round-trip terminates with both MessagePorts closed
Failed fixture readiness reclaims socket and child before the next case
Ready handshake precedes behavioral cancellation deadline

tasks.title: Move compiler probes outside source includes
tasks.summary: Migrate typecheckAgainstPanel and every caller to the approved async snippet-factory contract and retained compiler lifecycle in the ignored run workspace.
acceptanceChecks: Snippets import real panel types with correct NodeNext/package resolution; intended negative diagnostic and positive controls remain enforced.
Launch failure/unrelated diagnostics/timeouts cannot pass negative type tests; catchable interruption drains compiler.
No probe file enters backend or extension source includes, including after interruption; normal extension typecheck still works.

tests.name: Real panel type probes preserve positive and intended-negative diagnostics
Compiler launch failure and interruption cannot pass a negative probe or pollute source includes

tasks.title: Validate and document the supported harness
tasks.summary: Run isolated adversarial controls then sequential affected suites; document selectors, runtime setup, budgets, recovery and remaining sibling failures in the audit/index.
acceptanceChecks: All local ac1–ac6 checks have recorded evidence including contention, runtime drift, failed startup, positive/negative probes, interruption and blocked recovery.
No overlapping broad sweeps; broaden only after focused controls pass and prior actors close; report actual pass/fail/cancelled coverage and environment.
Document explicit abrupt-death limits and recovery; preserve sibling failures/security refusals and leave release qualification pending.
Inspect generated sequence source against implementation ordering and verify rendering if available; report unavailable evidence.
Exercise real catchable signals separately from abandoned/replaced-record controls; do not claim all detached descendants can be reclaimed after arbitrary SIGKILL.

tests.name: Sequential focused validation reports actual coverage, remaining failures and closed actors
Documented runtime, selector, budget and blocked-recovery commands match observed behavior

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: unsupported Node exits before output mutation
a changed lease or source/output fingerprint never produces successful validation
one checkout owner protects prepared output from a second test or build
output-mutating tests run alone and ordinary consumers reuse the prepared build
all nested Node and npm children use the validated runtime
a failing fixture closes its own socket and child before the next case
startup readiness is bounded separately from the asserted cancellation deadline
timeouts and unconfirmed cleanup remain nonzero incomplete results
type probes distinguish intended diagnostics from launch failure and retain positive controls
native refusal and saved-mode assertions are preserved
the coordinator uses existing build/process boundaries without production API changes
the peer-state fixture registers a real test and releases both ports
interrupted type probes cannot enter normal source includes
uncatchable owner death leaves blocked ownership without lock stealing

citations.quotedText: HarnessRunRecord, PreparedBuild and HarnessChild/ProbeWorkspace responsibilities and audited integration sites.
Async real-module type probes; ownership/runtime preconditions; failure detection, bounded drain and blocked recovery.
Local ac1–ac6 and all fourteen test-level subjects retain meaningful assertions and actual coverage.
Command routing, admitted asset sync, specialized-launcher ownership only, compatibility and qualification boundaries.
Approved LLD grounding reused for sizing. v2 is ahead one local approval commit and behind four upstream commits; reconcile before implementation. No tracker publication is claimed.

t4 validation found command routing deferred until t7 prevented t4 acceptance: npm test guidance remained unusable and raw npm build could race. It also required actual consumer invocations rather than repeated synthetic prerequisite checks. Move t7 immediately after validated t3 and require unchanged consumer assertion logs with explicit platform-failure accounting.
